videos.desc: A young man studying at a desk with an open textbook takes a break to look at his phone, laughing at what he sees. His amusement slowly turns into wide-eyed panic as he realizes how much study time his short break has eaten.
videos.said: I take a short break But I must study now

videos.desc: A teacher writes a quadratic equation on a chalkboard; every time she turns her back, her class erupts into total chaos with students dancing on desks and throwing paper. When she turns around with her coffee mug, everyone is sitting quietly, leaving her baffled.
videos.said: I look away for one second. My class is crazy!

videos.desc: A young woman sits at a table at home with an iced coffee, opens her laptop and calmly works through an online course, sipping and typing.
videos.said: I am at home. I take a course online.

videos.desc: A woman in a mustard coat walks through a grand old library, gazing up in awe at endless shelves and a huge circular tower packed with thousands of books.
videos.said: This library is beautiful. Look at all the books.

videos.desc: A student at a classroom desk needs a straight line but has no ruler. He comically tries the edge of a thick book and a calculator and even searches under the desks, until he finally gets a wooden ruler and happily draws a perfect straight line.
videos.said: A ruler makes us a straight line. I have no ruler!

videos.desc: A first-person tour of a school: walking up to the entrance doors at sunrise, through locker-lined hallways, past a classroom of chatting students, the library shelves and the cafeteria line, ending outside on the lawn in front of the school building.
videos.said: This is my school. Come and see it.

videos.desc: In a hallway of research posters a student glances at one and walks on, but a scientist in a white lab coat and safety glasses stops, inspects every chart up close, points at curves, scribbles notes on a clipboard and beams with excitement.
videos.said: A normal person looks fast. A scientist looks at everything.

videos.desc: A young woman in a red beret and glasses studies at a desk stacked with books while her mug of coffee steams; she reads for so long the coffee goes cold, so she comically dumps an ice tray into it, throws the window open and drinks it iced without stopping her studying.
videos.said: I am a student. I study until my coffee is cold.

videos.desc: A presenter in a cream blazer shows school subjects in quick cuts: equations on a blackboard, a calculator, paint and brush strokes, piano keys and sheet music, a glowing chemistry flask, then she leans on a stack of textbooks and talks to the camera.
videos.said: School has many subjects. Some subjects are very hard.

videos.desc: At night a woman in a beanie sets up a telescope on a tripod in her backyard and looks through it at the moon; magnified views show craters and a bright meteor streaking past a crescent moon, and she looks up amazed and tells the camera what she saw.
videos.said: I look at the moon with my telescope. I see something amazing!

videos.desc: A student sits at a small desk flipping through an enormous, thick textbook, turning page after page with a bored face; the pages never seem to end, and she finally gives up and falls asleep with her head on the book.
videos.said: My textbook is very long. It is so boring.

videos.desc: A huge university lecture hall is packed with hundreds of students on laptops and phones in week one; the camera then shows the same auditorium in week five, with row after row of empty seats and only a couple of students left.
videos.said: In week one, my university is full. In week five, it is empty.

videos.desc: A young man in a basketball jersey sits at a dim table completely covered in exam papers and worksheets; he leans over the pages, flips through them and gives up, walking away from the table.
videos.said: This exam's too hard, I just believe.

videos.desc: A close-up of a man's hands at a wooden office desk. He holds a small brass gyroscope, a shiny golden ball inside a thin ring, winds a string around its axle and pulls it hard. Then he lowers the gyroscope onto a small golden stand and lets go. The ring turns round and round so fast that it looks blurred, while the whole thing balances upright on the tip of the stand without falling. A grey printer, a pen holder and a roll of paper towels stand in the background.
videos.said: I do a fun experiment. It spins and does not fall.

videos.desc: A man films himself at his kitchen counter presenting his big desk calculator, admits he is bad at math, and demonstratively types 5 + 3 on it to get the answer 8.
videos.said: Okay, this is my calculator. I am bad at math. I use the calculator for small numbers.

videos.desc: In a black-and-white street interview a host quizzes young people with a microphone. A boy answers an easy question and a green 'Correct' pops up twice; a girl struggles with a simple math question and gets a red 'Wrong' before everyone laughs together.
videos.said: Alright easy one. What color is the sky blue? Okay, what is 23 plus 87 105 This answer is correct that answer is wrong

videos.desc: A girl excitedly shows a little Mount Fuji eraser in its Japanese box, then rubs out pencil scribbles on lined paper, leaving a pile of grey shavings. As she uses it the blue eraser wears into a snow-capped mountain shape and she holds up the tiny Fuji proudly.
videos.said: Look at my cute eraser. I use the eraser and the eraser becomes a little mountain. So pretty.

videos.desc: A tired teenage girl in glasses sits at a desk at night, chin propped on her hand over a pile of worksheets, sighs that tonight she does homework and then more homework, and starts writing with her pen.
videos.said: Tonight I do homework. Then I do more homework.

videos.desc: A teenage boy sits calmly at his desk with a tablet in a bright classroom while behind him classmates wrestle and pile on top of each other in growing chaos.

A young man in a beanie holds a green click pen up to the camera, clicks the button, then writes stripes in blue, red and other colors on a lined notebook and grins about how cool the multi-color pen is.
videos.said: Look at my pen. This pen is so cool. I click the pen and I write in many colors.

videos.desc: A young woman in a beret sketches a mountain landscape with a yellow pencil in an open notebook at a sunny wooden table, while a bearded man watches and applauds her finished drawing.
videos.said: Soft, then strong.

videos.desc: A stressed student at a desk piled with textbooks and a laptop presses her palms together, looks up at the ceiling and begs "Please, I pray for a good grade... I want to pass my exam". She dramatically pleads into the camera with clasped hands and desperate eyes.
videos.said: Please, I pray for a good grade. I pray and I pray. I want to pass my exam, please, or pass my--

videos.desc: A woman in a lab coat, safety goggles and purple gloves says she loves science, mixes two blue liquids in a beaker, and a huge tower of orange foam erupts out of it; she reacts wide-eyed with delight and holds up the foam-filled tube in triumph.
videos.said: I love science. Look what happens.

videos.desc: At a wooden table on a grassy steppe with a horse grazing behind, a young woman shows a blunt pencil, a man twists it in a small sharpener so a wood shaving curls out, and she holds up the now needle-sharp pencil before drawing in a notebook.
videos.said: Blunt as a spoon. Needle point.
